title: Assignment Value Bounded by the Optimum
statement: Let a constraint satisfaction instance have a finite, nonempty domain and a finite variable set. For every assignment of domain values to its variables, its fraction of satisfied constraints is at most the maximum such fraction over all assignments.
hypotheses_covered: The instance has a nonempty multiset of constraints
Every declared variable occurs in a constraint scope
An assignment from variables to domain values
